newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi 3-month T-bill rate up to 15.81 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malawi 3-month T-bill rate up to 15.81 pct.

text.p: BLANTYRE, Feb 3 (Reuter) The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills rose by 1.39 percent to 15.81 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 14.42 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Monday.
Applications for 126.24 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at an average price of 96.26 kwacha percent.
The average rate for six-month bills went up by 0.41 per cent to 15.80 per cent from 15.39 per cent two weeks ago.
Applications for 66.83 million kwacha of bills on offer were fully subscribed at the average price of 95.52 kwacha percent.
For nine-month bills, the average rate rose by 1.04 per cent to 15.79 from 14.75 per cent two weeks ago.
Applications for K99.41 million of bills on offer were also fully subscribed at the average price of 95.89 kwacha percent.
